summary: Of 27 candidates, 9 were confirmed, 18 corrected, 0 refuted and 0 unverified as wholes (D-10's money reach in production stays unverified inside a corrected verdict). The two P0s (O-01 Resend webhook store, O-02 sent outbox rows) are real but are retention in Blueprint's own admin-only store, not exposure, so both drop to P1, and O-01 stores no click links in production because no clicked events exist. B-06 is wrong that nothing reads the application's robot and jobs answers: the approver's card and Slack show them; the real defect is the hidden website field and a region check that cannot match states. D-17 is sharper than stated: the one approved company never accepted the Terms signed in, so no company can see any job, and D-09's staff hold should not be deleted without a privacy takedown to replace it; several copy and polish items (B-02, B-05, B-09, B-10, B-13, F-15, O-03, O-13) drop to P2.

checks: Opened server/routes/resend-webhook.ts:50-63: every event is stored with recipient and payload: envelope (whole Resend event, which carries data.subject); grep finds no reader of growth_campaign_events or growthCampaigns outside this file.

Production aggregate firestore-second-pass.json: growth_campaign_events 403, event types sent 173, delivered 129, bounced 46, suppressed 41, dropped 14, latest 2026-11-20; no clicked events, so no click link, IP or browser is stored in production today.
verdicts.change_safe_why: Suppression (recordEmailSuppression, lines 84-99) is the only part with an effect and stays; the eventRef existence check also serves as webhook dedupe, so without the write a replayed webhook re-runs recordEmailSuppression, which is a harmless upsert. Purging the 403 docs is a production write the owner approves.
verdicts.corrections: Click links, IP addresses and browsers are not stored in production: there are no clicked events (click tracking is not producing events). What is stored is the recipient address and subject of every email, including site and company job emails. This is retention in an internal admin-only store, not exposure, so P1 rather than P0.
verdicts.corrected_title: The Resend webhook keeps every email's recipient and subject in a collection nobody reads
verdicts.corrected_today: 403 stored events (latest 2026-11-20) hold each email's recipient address and the full Resend payload including the subject; nothing reads or deletes them and withdrawal does not touch them.
